channel.title: MYRSS Daily Digest
channel.description: Daily world-affairs curation: two selections each from de Volkskrant, New York Times, Follow the Money, Reuters and The New Yorker. Most summaries rely on RSS headlines and descriptions; Reuters articles additionally checked. Source feeds last refreshed on 19 November 2026 around 07:00 UTC.

item.title: de Volkskrant | Brussel wil nieuwe miljardenlening om Oekraïne sterke positie aan de onder­handelings­tafel te geven
item.description: de Volkskrant reports that the European Commission wants a new multibillion-euro loan to strengthen Ukraine's negotiating position. Headline-only summary; no full article was accessed.

item.title: de Volkskrant | Persorganisatie: Israël demoniseerde Palestijnse journalisten en doodde ze erna
item.description: According to de Volkskrant's headline, a press organisation alleges that Israel demonised Palestinian journalists before killing them. This is an attributed allegation, not independently established here; headline-only summary.

item.title: New York Times | How the War in Iran Will Remake the Global Energy Order
item.description: The Times' RSS summary says an International Energy Agency analysis finds that the Iran war's oil shock could accelerate adoption of alternative energy sources. Based on RSS metadata, not a full-article reading.

item.title: New York Times | Putin Returns to APEC ‘Family Photo,’ Testing Western Leaders
item.description: The Times reports that Australian and Canadian leaders defended joining an APEC group photograph with Putin as a courtesy to China, despite domestic criticism. Based on the RSS summary.

item.title: Follow the Money | De vergeten oorzaak van de huurcrisis: de koper woont in een fiscaal paleis
item.description: FTM argues that favourable tax treatment of homeownership, rather than only rental regulation, is an overlooked driver of the shrinking Dutch private rental sector. Its RSS summary says 70,000 homes left that sector in two years; this is FTM's account.

item.title: Follow the Money | Gelekte bank­documenten: Hongaarse partner van ING faciliteerde Russische witwas­praktijken
item.description: FTM reports, citing leaked banking documents, that a major Hungarian bank linked to ING facilitated Russian money-laundering practices involving a Kremlin-connected oligarch. This reflects the publisher's RSS allegations, not independent verification.

item.title: Reuters | EXCLUSIVE: UniCredit and Germany reach broad agreement on Commerzbank takeover
item.description: Reuters reports that UniCredit and Germany reached broad agreement on key terms of a Commerzbank takeover, including retaining the German headquarters in Frankfurt. Reuters article reporting was consulted.

item.title: Reuters | EXCLUSIVE: Anthropic clinches biggest-ever IPO with $81 billion offering
item.description: Reuters reports that Anthropic's initial public offering raised about $81.31 billion at $83 per share, a record stock-market debut. Reuters article reporting was consulted.

item.title: The New Yorker | “Sense of Water” Is an Iranian Exile’s Love Letter to Farsi
item.description: Wind-down: The New Yorker's film piece describes Mohammad Rasoulof's 'Sense of Water' as an Iranian exile's love letter to Farsi, drawing a parallel with the director's own flight to Germany. Based on the RSS summary.

item.title: The New Yorker | “On the Calculation of Volume” Enters a New Phase
item.description: Wind-down: A literary review of Book V in Solvej Balle's time-loop series, in which its characters settle into November 18 as a more permanent home. Based on the RSS summary.
